_doc: UI-test av redigeringsläget i The Character Creator (studio/human_edit.js, tools/character/human/EDITS.md): syssling_wrap16 öppnas i editorn, nätet ur _edit.json ligger där figuren ritas, en tinning dras in i posen med spegling (tvillingen följer speglad, vilan via pose_to_rest), Point och Brush med riktiga pekardrag i den platta vyn, Undo, Save bygger om till syssling_wrap16_e<n> med ändringarna, flödesraden visar stegen, och Textures bakar detaljernas normalkarta (några minuter). Ta bort assets/characters/syssling_wrap16_e* och build/human/edits/syssling_wrap16_v* efteråt. Kör mot studio-test: url med port 8771.
name: creator_edit

steps.label: a fitted figure can be opened in the editor

steps.eval: (() => { const T = __studio.human.scene.constructor; const b = new (Object.getPrototypeOf(__studio.human.camera.position).constructor)(); const box = { min: [Infinity, Infinity, Infinity], max: [-Infinity, -Infinity, -Infinity] }; __studio.human.figure.updateMatrixWorld(true); __studio.human.figure.traverse((o) => { if (!o.isMesh || !/female|male/i.test(o.name)) return; const p = o.geometry.attributes.position; for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) { b.fromBufferAttribute(p, i).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld); for (const [k, a] of ['x', 'y', 'z'].entries()) { box.min[k] = Math.min(box.min[k], b[a]); box.max[k] = Math.max(box.max[k], b[a]); } } }); window.__figBox = box; return box; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const [lo, hi] = __studio.human.editor.test.bbox(), f = window.__figBox; return [0, 1, 2].every((k) => Math.abs(lo[k] - f.min[k]) < 0.005 && Math.abs(hi[k] - f.max[k]) < 0.005); })()
steps.label: the editor's mesh (from _edit.json, Pose) lies where the figure is drawn, within 5 mm
in edit mode only the Edit points card shows and the figure gives way to the editable mesh

steps.eval: (() => { const e = __studio.human.editor.test, [lo, hi] = e.bbox(), top = hi[1]; const c = e.find((x, y, z) => y > top - 0.135 && y < top - 0.10 && z > 0 && x > 0); c.sort((a, b) => e.rest(b)[0] - e.rest(a)[0]); window.__tv = c[0]; window.__r0 = e.rest(c[0]); window.__p0 = e.pose(c[0]); window.__tw = e.twin(c[0]); window.__w0 = e.rest(window.__tw); return { temple: c[0], twin: window.__tw, rest: window.__r0 }; })()

steps.label: the temple point has a mirror twin on the other side

steps.eval: (() => { __studio.human.editor.test.move([[__tv, [-0.004, 0, 0]]]); const e = __studio.human.editor.test, r = e.rest(__tv), p = e.pose(__tv), w = e.rest(__tw); return { pose_d: p.map((x, k) => x - __p0[k]), rest_d: r.map((x, k) => x - __r0[k]), twin_d: w.map((x, k) => x - __w0[k]) }; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const e = __studio.human.editor.test, p = e.pose(__tv), r = e.rest(__tv), w = e.rest(__tw); const pd = p.map((x, k) => x - __p0[k]), rd = r.map((x, k) => x - __r0[k]), wd = w.map((x, k) => x - __w0[k]); return Math.abs(pd[0] + 0.004) < 1e-5 && Math.abs(pd[1]) < 1e-5 && Math.abs(Math.hypot(...rd) - 0.004) < 0.0015 && Math.abs(wd[0] + rd[0]) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(wd[1] - rd[1]) < 1e-6 && Math.abs(wd[2] - rd[2]) < 1e-6; })()
steps.label: a 4 mm move in the Pose lands in the rest pose via pose_to_rest, and the twin moves mirrored

steps.eval: (() => { const e = __studio.human.editor.test, [lo, hi] = e.bbox(), top = hi[1]; const c = e.find((x, y, z) => y > top - 0.30 && y < top - 0.26 && z > 0.05 && x > 0.04 && x < 0.08); window.__pv = c[0]; window.__pr = e.rest(c[0]); const [x, y] = e.screen(c[0]); window.__drag = [[x, y], [x + 10, y], [x + 25, y - 6]]; return { v: c[0], at: [x, y] }; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const r = __studio.human.editor.test.rest(__pv); return Math.hypot(r[0] - __pr[0], r[1] - __pr[1], r[2] - __pr[2]) > 0.003 && __studio.human.editor.test.selected.includes(__pv); })()
steps.label: Point: a real drag on a point in the front view selects and moves it

steps.eval: (() => { __studio.human.editor.test.set('tool', 'brush'); const e = __studio.human.editor.test, [lo, hi] = e.bbox(); const c = e.find((x, y, z) => y > hi[1] * 0.55 && y < hi[1] * 0.58 && z > 0.08 && Math.abs(x) < 0.03); window.__bv = c[0]; window.__br = e.rest(c[0]); const [x, y] = e.screen(c[0]); window.__drag = [[x, y], [x, y - 8], [x, y - 20]]; return c[0]; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const r = __studio.human.editor.test.rest(__bv); return Math.hypot(r[0] - __br[0], r[1] - __br[1], r[2] - __br[2]) > 0.003; })()
steps.label: Brush: a real drag on the belly moves the surface under the brush

steps.eval: (() => { __studio.human.editor.test.undo(); const r = __studio.human.editor.test.rest(__bv); return Math.hypot(r[0] - __br[0], r[1] - __br[1], r[2] - __br[2]); })()

steps.expect: (() => { const r = __studio.human.editor.test.rest(__bv); return Math.hypot(r[0] - __br[0], r[1] - __br[1], r[2] - __br[2]) < 1e-6; })()
steps.label: Undo takes the brush stroke back

steps.eval: (async () => { const n = __studio.human.from.slice(6); const d = await fetch(`/assets/characters/${n}/${n}_edit.json?v=${Date.now()}`).then((r) => r.json()); const i = __tv; window.__built = { name: n, offset: [d.offsets[3 * i], d.offsets[3 * i + 1], d.offsets[3 * i + 2]], rest: [d.rest[3 * i], d.rest[3 * i + 1], d.rest[3 * i + 2]], want: __save.tv, recipeEdits: __studio.human.openSaved?.recipe?.edits }; return window.__built; })()

steps.expect: (() => { const r = window.__built; return r && [0, 1, 2].every((k) => Math.abs(r.rest[k] - __save.tv[k]) < 2e-4) && /build\/human\/edits\/syssling_wrap16_v\d+\.json$/.test(r.recipeEdits ?? ''); })()
steps.label: Save writes a new edits file and builds a new figure whose rest pose has the edit (within 0.2 mm)

steps.expect: (() => { const st = Object.fromEntries(__studio.human.steps.map((x) => [x.id, x.state])); return st.body === 'done' && st.edit === 'done' && st.textures === 'todo' && st.done === 'todo' && ['done', 'todo'].includes(st.concept) && document.querySelectorAll('.hu-steps .hu-step').length === 6; })()
steps.label: the flow bar shows the edited figure: body and edit done, textures and finished to do
Textures bakes the detail normal map to a new <name>_detail.glb, and the flow bar marks textures as half done
